listen_address.description: IP address the proxy listens on for incoming IMAP client connections.

listen_port.description: Port number the proxy listens on for IMAP connections (typically 143 for unencrypted or 993 for SSL).

backends.description: List of backend IMAP servers to proxy requests to. Supports weighted round-robin if multiple servers are listed.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the backend IMAP server.

port.description: Port number of the backend IMAP server (usually 143 or 993).

weight.description: Relative weight for load distribution (higher = more traffic). Must be ≥ 1.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS termination at the proxy level (proxy presents its own certificate to clients).

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format). Required if ssl_enabled=true.

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format). Required if ssl_enabled=true.

cache_size.description: Maximum number of IMAP connections cached per backend server.

connection_cache_ttl.description: Time-to-live (seconds) for cached backend connections before reconnection.

max_client_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for logging (e.g., 'mail', 'daemon', 'local0').

chroot.description: Chroot directory for sandboxing (leave empty to disable chroot).

user.description: Unix user to drop privileges to after binding to ports.

group.description: Unix group to drop privileges to after binding to ports.

client_idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before closing idle client connections.

backend_idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before closing idle backend connections (should be ≥ client_idle_timeout).

enable_pipeline.description: Enable IMAP pipeline support for improved performance (requires backend support).
